definitions.explanation: A ceremony held in January for those who turned 20 during the past year.

notes:
{成人式|せいじんしき} is a ceremony celebrating young people reaching adulthood. It is one of Japan's most visible cultural traditions.

DATE:
Held on ⟦{成人|せいじん}→成人：03378_seijin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Coming of Age Day), the second Monday of January.

- Women: ⟦{振袖|ふりそで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧ (long-sleeved kimono) — the most iconic image of the day
- Men: ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧ or ⟦{袴|はかま}→袴：02245_hakama⟧ (traditional hakama)

WHAT HAPPENS:
⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦{自治体|じちたい}→自治体：13946_jichitai⟧ (local governments) organize ceremonies with speeches. Afterwards, groups of friends often gather for reunions with former classmates.

In 2022, the legal age of adulthood was lowered from 20 to 18, but most municipalities still hold ceremonies for those turning 20, sometimes renamed ⟦{二十歳|はたち}→二十歳：02933_hatachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つどい.
